_comment: Per NVD product name: vendors whose rows for that name describe a different product. cvescan does not match these rows when the scanned CPE names another vendor, and logs the CVE as skipped (other_vendor). Add a vendor only after reading its CVEs. A rename of the same product (exim -> university_of_cambridge, igor_sysoev -> f5) does not belong here.

http_server.akka: Akka HTTP, a Scala/Java library (CVE-2017-1000118, CVE-2021-42697, CVE-2023-44487)

python.microsoft: the Python extension for Visual Studio Code (CVE-2020-1171, CVE-2024-49050, ...)
